📖 Step-by-Step Guide

Let's walk through everything together — no prior experience needed!

🔙

Step 1: Create Your Account

The very first thing you need to do is create a free account. It takes less than 30 seconds.

The ComplianceOS Sign-In page — enter your email and password to access your dashboard

How to get started:

  1. Open ComplianceOS in your web browser
  2. Click “Sign Up” to create a new account
  3. Enter your Full Name, Email, and Password
  4. Click the orange “Create Account” button
  5. Check your email for a confirmation link and click it
  6. Come back and Sign In with your new credentials
💡 Tip Already have an account? Simply enter your email and password on the Sign In page and click the orange button. That's it — you're in!
📊

Step 2: Your Compliance Dashboard

After signing in, you'll land on your Dashboard — your command center for all trade compliance.

The Compliance Dashboard — your command center showing risk overview, alerts, markets, and FTA coverage at a glance

What each section tells you:

Section What It Means Why It Matters
Overall Risk Your compliance health score (0–100) Green = safe · Orange = pay attention · Red = act now!
Critical Alerts Urgent regulatory changes needing attention Click to see approaching deadlines
Markets Countries you export to with their status See which markets need work at a glance
Active FTAs Trade agreements applying to your products Can save you significant import duty!
Quick Actions One-click buttons for key features Fast access to Risk Analysis, Checklists, and Alerts
Recent Alerts Latest regulatory updates Stay informed without checking government websites
ℹ️ Navigation Look at the sidebar on the left — this is how you move between different sections of ComplianceOS. We'll explore each one now.
🔍

Step 3: Risk Analysis

Click “Risk Analysis” in the sidebar — see exactly what risks exist for your products and markets.

Risk Analysis page — view risk factors and recommendations for each target market

How to use it:

  1. Your product and selected markets are shown at the top
  2. The Risk Gauge shows your overall score for each country
  3. Below, Risk Factors show what specific regulations affect you
  4. Click any factor to see detailed recommendations
  5. Compare different markets to understand where your risks are highest
Risk Factor Severity What It Means
CBAM Carbon Reporting High EU requires carbon emission data for steel, aluminum, cement
ESG Scope 3 Disclosure Medium Some markets require supply chain sustainability reporting
Active FTA Benefits Positive A trade agreement that reduces your import duties!
✅

Step 4: Compliance Checklists

Click “Checklists” — your auto-generated to-do list for every shipment. Never miss a document again.

Interactive compliance checklists with progress tracking — organized by document category

How to use it:

  1. Choose your target market using the country tabs at the top
  2. See the progress bar showing how many items you’ve completed
  3. Items are organised into categories: Documentation, Certifications, Indian Compliance
  4. Click any item to mark it as complete ✓
  5. Watch the progress bar fill up as you check off items!
💡 Smart Checklists The checklist adapts automatically based on your product and destination. Exporting food to the EU? It includes FSSAI and phytosanitary certificates. Exporting chemicals to Japan? Different safety certs appear. ComplianceOS remembers so you don't have to.
🔔

Step 5: Regulatory Alerts

Click “Alerts” — your early warning system for regulatory changes.

Regulatory alerts filtered by severity — Critical, Warning, and Info updates

How to use it:

  1. Use the filter buttons at the top — All, Critical, Warning, or Info
  2. Each alert shows what's happening, how urgent it is, and the deadline
  3. Click any alert for detailed information and regulation citations
  4. Each alert includes clear action items — exactly what you need to do
Alert Severity Action Required
EU Digital Product Passport Critical Register products in EU database before deadline
CBAM Carbon Reporting Q1 Warning Submit quarterly emission data by filing date
EUDR Deforestation Rules Critical Prepare supply chain documentation
India-UK FTA Negotiations Info Monitor for updates — potential new trade benefits
⚠️ Important Never ignore Critical alerts! These have tight deadlines and failing to comply can result in shipments being held, heavy fines, or export bans.
💸

Step 6: FTA & Schemes — Save Money

Click “FTA & Schemes” — discover Free Trade Agreements and export schemes that reduce your duties.

FTA & Schemes analysis — see active trade agreements and potential duty savings for your products

What you'll find here:

  1. FTA Cards — Agreement name, status (Active / Under Negotiation), and duty savings
  2. Tariff Comparison — Standard rates vs. preferential rates side by side
  3. Indian Export Schemes — Government incentives like RoDTEP, PLI, Advance Authorization
  4. Savings Calculator — Potential duty savings for your specific product routes
💰 Did you know? Many exporters miss out on lakhs in duty savings because they don't file for preferential tariff rates under active FTAs. ComplianceOS identifies these automatically!
📦

Step 7: Shipment Tracking

Click “Shipments” — create and track individual shipments with per-shipment compliance scores.

Shipment tracking — each shipment shows product, destination, date, status, and compliance score

How to use it:

  1. Click the orange “+ New Shipment” button at the top right
  2. Enter Shipment Name, Product, Destination, and Date
  3. Click “Create Shipment” — a checklist and risk score are auto-generated
  4. Monitor the compliance score — it updates as you check off items
  5. Click the dropdown arrow on any shipment for full details
⚠️ Compliance Score Guide A score below 50% means the shipment is NOT ready. Complete remaining checklist items before shipping to avoid costly delays at customs.
🏷️

Step 8: Label Validator

Click “Label Validator” — incorrect labeling is one of the top reasons shipments get held at customs.

Label Validator — check your product labels against destination-country requirements rule by rule

How to use it:

  1. Select your Product Category from the dropdown
  2. Choose the Destination Country from the tabs (EU, US, UK, UAE, Japan, Australia)
  3. ComplianceOS loads exact labeling rules — organized by Language, Origin, Identification, Environmental
  4. Toggle each requirement to check compliance — watch the score update in real-time
  5. Click the dropdown on any rule to see the specific regulation it comes from
  6. Use “Mark All Compliant” or “Reset All” for fast management
💡 Pro Tip Try switching countries! Requirements change entirely — EU requires official language labeling while UAE requires Arabic text and Halal certification. Always validate BEFORE printing.
⚙️

Step 9: Settings & Configuration

Click “Settings” at the bottom of the sidebar — configure ComplianceOS to match your business.

Settings — configure your company profile, product categories, target markets, and API integrations

What to configure:

Setting What to Enter Why It Matters
Company Profile Name, size, IEC number Risk scores adjust based on company size
Product Categories Steel, Textiles, Food, Chemicals, etc. Determines which regulations apply to you
Target Markets EU, US, UK, UAE, Japan, Australia Generates country-specific checklists and alerts
API Keys External data source keys Advanced customs system integration
ℹ️ Quick Note You can change settings anytime. As your business grows into new markets, update your profile and ComplianceOS will immediately recalculate everything.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to be a compliance expert to use ComplianceOS?
Not at all! ComplianceOS is designed for exporters of all sizes. The platform explains every regulation in plain language and tells you exactly what to do.
Which countries does ComplianceOS support?
We currently cover EU, US, UK, UAE, Japan, and Australia — the major export destinations. We're constantly expanding.
How does ComplianceOS know what regulations apply to me?
Based on your product categories and target markets in Settings, ComplianceOS automatically maps the applicable regulations, generates relevant checklists, and surfaces the right alerts.
Can multiple team members use ComplianceOS?
Yes! Each team member can create their own account and collaborate on compliance together.
What if a regulation changes?
ComplianceOS monitors changes in real-time. You'll receive an alert the moment something changes that affects your exports.
Is my data secure?
Yes. ComplianceOS uses enterprise-grade security with encrypted data storage and secure authentication.
